questions.prompt: A log has a full first system message and one later system message with only sections: { skills: "..." }. What is the prompt in force after both?
options: Only the skills section, because it is the newest
The first message with its skills section replaced and every other section unchanged
The first message unchanged, because patches are ignored
The later message with all other sections removed
questions.explanation: A patch replaces only the sections it names. Replaying the first message and then the patch gives the current prompt.

questions.prompt: How does a patch remove a section from the prompt?
options: It sets the section to null
It sends an empty system message
It deletes the old system message from the file
It adds the section name to toolsRemoved
questions.explanation: In the sections map, a value of null removes that section. toolsRemoved lists tools, not sections.

questions.prompt: Why does the log give an expert value when the prompt is stored this way?
options: The model reads the log faster
The log alone shows which instructions and tools the model had at every point
The prompt can no longer change during a session
The log makes the prompt shorter
questions.explanation: Because each change is a message in the log, replaying the log up to any point shows the exact prompt and tools then in force.
